name: Ice Crack Text
description: Lettering made of ice that cracks in branching lines under the pointer and shatters into angular shards that hang, then draw back together.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. It stays real text laid out by the page in the inherited font; the ice is painted in exactly the same glyph shapes.

props.name: seed
props.description: Seeds the crack paths, the shard pattern and the frozen streaks inside the letters. The same seed cracks the same way.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, an inline block. Moving the pointer over the letters starts cracks there, which heal a moment after it leaves; pressing breaks the word apart. Other span props are passed through. Under reduced motion the plain text is shown.
